title: Figure 21: Comparison of Known and Unknown Object Sightings by Duration, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" (left) and "Unknown" (right) object sightings, in percent, across duration categories from "5 seconds or less" through "More than 30 minutes", plus "Not stated". Both axes run from 0 to 30 percent. Caption: "FIGURE 21 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY DURATION, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7499.
